selected_rules.multilayer_via_guidance: Via pad diameter should be 0.10 mm larger than hole; 0.15 mm preferred. Requested 0.30/0.45 meets preferred difference. Published extra charges apply 0.10/0.15 mm holes or 0.20/0.25 mm holes with pads below 0.45 mm.

scope: Published capability screen, not order-specific CAM acceptance or guaranteed minimum copper/plating. Via-size guidance is distinct from component PTH annular-ring guidance.
